sources.ai_use: Permitted: CC0 1.0 dedicates the data to the public domain
sources.redistribution: Permitted (CC0 1.0). Attribution requested: City of Minneapolis, MapIT Minneapolis
sources.notes: Feature service layer 0, 1,308 polygons, fields Land_Use (district name) and Land_Use_Code (district code); data last edited 2026-10-30. Requested with geometry as GeoJSON (WGS84). The Hub (opendata.minneapolismn.gov) has Crawl-delay 60, so the ArcGIS Online feature service behind it is queried; services.arcgis.com answers 403 'Invalid URL' to /robots.txt, which the collector treats as no robots rules, as for the Denver and DC services. The layer is the City's planning layer; the Zoning Code and the City's map are the authority.
